name: MechaWar #3318
description: MechaWar Forge v2 — 7,777 combat mechas on BNB Chain. Each wallet's first mecha is FREE, then 0.0003 BNB per mint. Forge lower tiers up the ladder: 3 Scout to 1 Vanguard, 2 Vanguard to 1 Titan, 2 Titan to 1 Warlord, 2 Warlord to 1 Prime, 2 Prime to 1 Omega. Six classes: Scout, Vanguard, Titan, Warlord, Prime, and the mythic Omega.
